# Psalm 54 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. With-stringed-instruments. A-Maskil of-David, when the-Ziphites came and-said to-Saul, 'Is not David hiding among-us?'

**2** O-God, by-Your-name save-me, and-by-Your-might vindicate-me.

**3** O-God, hear my-prayer; give-ear to-the-words of-my-mouth.

**4** For strangers have-risen against-me, and-violent-men seek my-soul; they-do-not set God before-them. Selah.

**5** Behold, God [is] my-helper; the-Lord [is] the-sustainer of-my-soul.

**6** He-returns the-evil to-my-enemies; in-Your-faithfulness destroy-them.

**7** With-a-freewill-offering I-sacrifice to-You; I-give-thanks to-Your-name, YHWH, for [it is] good.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **54:2**: 'By Your name' — God's name represents His character and power. Salvation comes through who God is.

— EMET
